**Architecture constraints — export flow**

- `POST /api/admin/export` stays synchronous, inside monolith
- `workers/exporter.ts` behind flag `export-worker-v2` — do not enable
- Touch export auth → run both `tests/export/api.test.ts` + `tests/export/worker.test.ts`
- No Redis this milestone
- Ops dashboard needs immediate status — no background-only UX
